==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, Skelebot, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow. Leon first appeared in my dreams on 06/11/2025.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet. I befriended him in a dream on 08/03/2025.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light. I created him in a dream on 09/06/2025.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. I discovered the power of Lucid Light in a dream on 07/19/2025.) (Skelebot is a robot created by Johnson to act as the team's humanoid speedster. He was created in a dream on 09/21/2025.)
Celestial Dragon Jet is dying. (Celestial Dragon Jet was attacked by Acid Jet in my dream on 09/25/2025. Celestial Dragon Jet is a redeemed variant of me, that I freed from corruption via time travel on 09/13/2025. Acid Jet is a villainous variant of me, who wants to reshape the Storyverse in his image. Acid Jet is the being that originally corrupted Celestial Dragon Jet. Celestial Dragon Jet was nearly killed by Acid Jet during the 09/25/2025 attack. This dream picks up where that one left off, after Acid Jet was banished out of Leon into the Storyverse.)
I used the Ligo spell to connect him to a star to boost his power exponentially. (I discovered that the Latin word "Ligo" could act as a magic spell that creates links between targets in a dream on 06/23/2025. I believed that since he had Celestial Dragon based powers, that he likely drew power from stars. I was right.)
He rapidly healed but he had to leave to learn to control his new power. (His power increased faster than he could control it, so he actually posed a threat to us. That's why he had to leave so quickly. Without proper control, he's more dangerous than he is helpful. With that being said, he is still an ally.)
